inputs.text: [excited] skoo… TEL… oh… SOR… us. [curious] In Latin, "scutellum" means a little shield.
[happily] Yep — because of the hundreds of tiny bony plates on its back. [calm] It lived in Arizona, a hundred ninety-six million years ago.
[curious] Were there dangers around, back then?
[confident] Dilophosaurus, a big crested hunter, [serious] prowled that same area.
